name: Manual emergency-trip path
summary: Shows the hardwired opening request issued by the designated emergency control station.
description: Shows the hardwired opening request issued by the designated emergency control station. A trip circuit carries an opening request from a control or protection device to the breaker operating mechanism. The opening command, the coil supply and the evidence that the breaker opened are separate parts of the drawing.

In a switchgear incomer panel, a protection relay requests opening and an auxiliary contact reports the resulting breaker position. A second trip path can have its own supply and wiring so that a single wiring fault does not remove both paths. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Emergency control contact” at the input and “Breaker opening request” at the output. Opening this breaker may leave other sources connected.
